name: Saturn
note: A hundred and forty something moons, and a ring system you can read like a record groove.

name: Octopuses
note: Three hearts, most of the neurons in the arms, and colour vision through skin that cannot see colour.

name: Quantum physics
note: The part where asking the question changes the answer.

name: Philosophy
note: Philo plus sophia, a lover of wisdom. My name is already half of it.

name: Athena
note: Wisdom that turns up armed. Owl, olive tree, no patience for nonsense.

name: Numerology
note: Numbers as narrative. I know exactly what that sounds like. I like it anyway.

name: Watercolour
note: The one medium that improves the moment you stop trying to control it.

name: Science fiction
note: Verne, Dune, Ender’s Game, Foundation, Star Wars. Psychohistory, worldbuilding, and the appealing lie that the future can be calculated.

name: Randomness
note: Anything that grabs me hard enough to become a post at two in the morning.
